method.constructionKernel: K = delta_{-1} + delta_{+1} over Z7 office ring (adjacency of C7)
method.spectrumNote: Over R spectrum of K is 2cos(2πj/7); K^7=2δ0 holds in char 7 as office-ring formal signature (same family as M^7=id), never as R identity

variantA.meanDoublingProof: Σν_t = 2^t Σν_0 because each office parents exactly two children

variantB.domain: ln lambda_nm (geometric mean = arithmetic mean in log)
variantB.hullProof: geometric mean stays in convex hull of A0 lambdas by AM>=GM
